title: RAISE pledging initiative launched for AI in science
dek: Companies and philanthropic organisations are invited to support researchers who use AI, mainly with models, computing capacity, software, data and training.
key_facts: RAISE pledging initiative (Resource for AI Science in Europe)
European AI in Science Summit, Dublin
Voluntary, mainly in kind: AI models, computing capacity, research software, data and training
Mistral AI–CERN partnership on a physics foundation model; RAISE Hub, Forum and Observatory live
body: At the European AI in Science Summit in Dublin, the European Commission launched the RAISE pledging initiative, inviting companies and philanthropic organisations to support researchers who use AI in science.
Pledges are voluntary and mainly in kind: access to AI models, computing capacity, research software, data and training.
Mistral AI and CERN announced a partnership to develop the largest foundation model in physics, and the RAISE Hub, Forum and Observatory went live. Pledges will be reviewed every year.
why: RAISE is becoming the EU's umbrella for AI in science, and it already has its own Horizon Europe call in Cluster 4. For technology providers, a pledge is a low-cost way to gain visibility with research organisations and with the Commission ahead of future RAISE funding rounds.
